question: What is the total area of the state of Bihar?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__94,163km².__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Total Area of the State of Bihar is **94,163km².**
 
• Bihar, a State of the country has the 13th largest geographical area.
 
• Bihar is the Third Largest state in terms of Population.
 
• The Total area of Bihar is 2.86% of the total geographical area of the country.
